TYPE workout

GOALS

    name "Maintain strength and muscle during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body & Core":
